limit.description: The maximum number of lines to read starting from offset. Must be a positive integer. Defaults to 2000 lines.

exclude.description: Multi-file reads: glob patterns to skip, e.g. ["**/*.test.ts"].

git_ignore.description: Multi-file reads: set false to stop skipping .gitignored files (default true).

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents (ripgrep syntax).

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match. Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match. Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-C.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match. Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Alias for -C; takes precedence over -C when both are set. Requires output_mode: "content".

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (default true). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

type.description: File type to search, for example "js", "py", "rust". More efficient than glob for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to the first N lines/entries (default 250). Works in all output modes. Pass 0 for unlimited.

offset.description: Skip the first N lines/entries before applying head_limit (default 0). Works in all output modes.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (default false).

name.description: The skill name exactly as listed in <available_skills>.

arguments.description: Optional arguments for the skill, as a single string (what a user would type after "/name").

description.description: A short (3-5 word) label for this task, shown to the user while the sub-agent works.

subagent_type.description: Which sub-agent to run — pick the one whose purpose matches the task. Omit to use 'general'.

agent_id.description: The agent_id returned when the task was launched. Omit to list all background agents.

query.description: The capability you need, e.g. "schedule a recurring job". Or select:web_search,web_fetch for exact names.
